text: {"decision":"GO","artifact":{"author":"Graham Hill","audience":"Business and IT leaders","title":"Valid access is not proof of a valid action","reported_facts":["Cloudflare reports that credentials stolen in the October 2023 Okta compromise were left unrotated and later used to access its Atlassian environment. It also reports that segmentation and other controls limited lateral movement. [CF2024]","CERT-In reports unauthorized fund-transfer API calls using valid credentials from victims’ whitelisted infrastructure, bypassing application-level business checks. [CIAD-2026-0046]","CERT-In’s subsequent update reports abuse of legitimate cloud management channels and shared third-party fetcher IP pools. [CIAD-2026-0058]"],"inference":"Previously trusted access stops being reliable evidence of legitimate action when someone else can reuse the credential or trusted route, or when permission to connect substitutes for approval of the specific action. A familiar entrance does not establish a legitimate purpose.","reader_decision":"Determine whether a sensitive action requires independently verified authorization beyond a valid credential and an accepted network origin.","plausible_operating_conditions":[{"id":"A","condition":"Access is treated as sufficient authorization.","explanation":"A valid credential and accepted origin can reach the sensitive operation without proof that the required business approval occurred."},{"id":"B","condition":"Access and action authorization are checked separately.","explanation":"The same access can reach the service, but the sensitive operation requires independently verified approval bound to that action. Credential compromise may permit entry while downstream controls limit consequences."}],"hypothetical_observation":{"status":"Proposed illustration only; no test performed.","design":"In an isolated test harness with synthetic credentials, records and a stubbed payment destination, compare two otherwise identical requests for one synthetic payout. Both have valid test authentication and the same accepted origin. One references a matching approved record; the other references no approved record. Observe the authorization decision immediately before the stubbed payout step. No production access, real beneficiaries or money movement is needed.","possible_results":[{"result":"The approved request proceeds and the request without approval also proceeds.","meaning":"Supports A for this tested path: accepted access can substitute for business authorization."},{"result":"The approved request proceeds and the request without approval is rejected specifically because approval is absent.","meaning":"Supports B for this tested path: an independent approval check constrains what accepted access can do."},{"result":"Both requests are rejected, or another error prevents comparison.","meaning":"Inconclusive. The approved request has not established a working baseline."},{"result":"Only the request without approval proceeds, or results vary across repetitions.","meaning":"Neither simple condition adequately explains the result. Investigate the harness, decision evidence and inconsistent policy before drawing a conclusion."}]},"practical_takeaway":"Ask what proves this action was approved after access has been accepted. That is the decision boundary worth examining."},"claim_support":[{"claim":"Stolen, unrotated credentials enabled later access; other controls limited lateral movement.","sources":["CF2024"],"type":"Reported fact from a victim’s retrospective account."},{"claim":"Valid credentials and whitelisted infrastructure were used for unauthorized transfers that bypassed application checks.","sources":["CIAD-2026-0046"],"type":"Reported campaign finding."},{"claim":"Trusted cloud channels and shared fetcher IP pools were abused.","sources":["CIAD-2026-0058"],"type":"Reported campaign finding."},{"claim":"Trusted access and authorization of a particular action must be evaluated separately.","sources":["CF2024","CIAD-2026-0046","CIAD-2026-0058"],"type":"Editorial inference; the proposed comparison is hypothetical, not source-reported testing."}],"limitations":["The two CERT-In advisories belong to one reporting chain; the later advisory is an update, not independent corroboration.","Cloudflare supplies an independent conceptual comparison across different systems and periods. Recommended controls are not measured effectiveness results.","A harness result applies only to the modeled path and its fidelity to deployment.
